term: Make 150 summons in the current event.
Make 200 summons in the current event.
Make 50 summons in the current event.
Make 100 summons in the current event.

In the Regular Summon, if you fail to summon an SSR Combatant for <color=#ff7b11>50</color> consecutive attempts, the chance of obtaining an SSR Combatant increases from the original <color=#ff7b11>2%</color> to <color=#ff7b11>4%</color> on your next attempt. If you still don't summon an SSR Combatant, the chance will rise from <color=#ff7b11>4%</color> to <color=#ff7b11>6%</color> for the following summons, continuing this pattern with an increase of <color=#ff7b11>2%</color> each time until it reaches a <color=#ff7b11>100%</color> chance.\nAdditionally, in a ten-summon sequence, you are guaranteed to receive at least one SR Combatant.
